map.Lung-RADS 肺结节分层：实性结节 小于6mm 为 2 类、6–8mm 为: Lung-RADS nodule stratification: solid nodules <6 mm are category 2, 6-8 mm category 3, 8-15 mm category 4A, >=15 mm category 4B; part-solid or ground-glass nodules are upgraded by solid-component size and malignant features; growth and suspicious features raise the category.
map.较前增大/实性成分增长: Growth vs prior / solid component increased
map.影像呈典型恶性征象(分叶/毛刺/空泡): Typical malignant features on imaging (lobulation / spiculation / vacuole)
map.阴性(无结节/完全钙化等良性): Negative (no nodule / benign such as fully calcified)
map.3个月复查CT / PET-CT / 活检: Repeat CT / PET-CT / biopsy in 3 months
map.提示：本工具为基线筛查简化版，实际分类需结合结节形态、生长速率、既往史。直径取平: Note: this is a simplified baseline-screening version; real classification needs nodule morphology, growth rate and prior history. Diameter is the mean of long and short axes. Part-solid nodules need the solid component measured separately. Clinical reference only.
map.实性结节 6mm→2 类，12 月低剂量 CT 随访。: Solid nodule 6 mm -> category 2; low-dose CT follow-up in 12 months.
map.部分实性成分>10mm→4A/4B 类，建议 3 月复查或 PET-CT/活检。: Part-solid component >10 mm -> category 4A/4B; repeat in 3 months or PET-CT/biopsy advised.
map.4 类为可疑恶性需积极处理，并非确诊；最终靠病理。: Category 4 is suspicious for malignancy and needs action, but is not a diagnosis; pathology is definitive.
map.按类别 3–12 月不等，新发/增大提示升级。: Ranges 3-12 months by category; new or growing nodules prompt escalation.
map.结节(Lung-RADS)风险分层器，依据肺结节类型(实性/部分实性/磨玻璃)及: Nodule (Lung-RADS) Risk Stratifier classifies lung nodules by type (solid / part-solid / ground-glass) and size with Lung-RADS follow-up advice. A medical professional tool based on authoritative medical standards, for reference only.
